point_of_view.description: The author's stated beliefs, positions and the topics they own, written by the author. With own_urls, the author's own pages are a second source of their views.

topics.description: The topics the news searches covered; used to label stories.

avoid.description: Topics or kinds of news never to react to.

freshness_hours.description: A story published longer ago than this is stale.

now.description: Current time, ISO 8601. Optional: on JoyStream the template binds it to the run start time. Never guessed.

own_urls.description: Optional: addresses of the author's own pages (website, positioning pages, blog posts) that an earlier step read. Those pages are the author's writing, never news: they ground the take and are linked as the page a story relates to.

slack_brief.description: When true, also return `slack`: the picks laid out as one Slack message with a card per story, for the agent's post step.

brief_footer.description: Optional closing line for the Slack brief, e.g. 'Next brief tomorrow 8:00 AM PT'.
